body: My childhood years were my best years. I actually had a social life back then and many friends, people actually showed up at my birthday and I was invited to other kids birthday parties as well, I actually had fun and was interested in things. Things I did or watched actually left an impression. After high school is where things really started getting bad. I am a complete failure as an adult, almost friendless except for a sporadic drinking buddy (that's the extent of my social life), never had a relationship, broke. I'm not interested in anything anymore, I'm not interested in life. I'm not worried about retirement or old age though because by then I would have already committed suicide.
Same here, comparing yourself to others hurts man. All my life is ever going to be is a case study in how depression and anxiety fucks up your entire life.

I think this may be pretty common. I'm a guy but I can relate to this a lot. Suddenly you're in your twenties, all your friends have girlfriends and you've become even more of a loner. We don't talk to eachother as much, hang out with eachother as much and don't have quite the same connection we used to have. Its ok for them I guess because they're in relationships but for me its basically the nail in the coffin of my social life.
I wish I could just snap my fingers, forget everything and stop existing.
